name: Danish National School of Performing Arts
sector: institutioner inden for arkitektur og kunst
summary: Denmark's national school of performing arts, regulated by the Ministry of Culture. Its one English-taught bachelor, Dance and Choreography, takes its 2027 intake in Holstebro, in western Jutland. Entry is by audition only; the deadline is 1 December 2026, not 15 March.
about: The school trains actors, dancers, musical performers, directors, playwrights and production staff, with its main address at Holmen in Copenhagen and campuses elsewhere in Denmark. Dance and Choreography is its only bachelor taught entirely in English, and about half its students come from abroad. Places are decided by audition, not grades.

ib.text: No formal entry requirements: an IB Diploma or DP Course Results both let you apply. Places go to the strongest applicants after a video audition and a three-day second audition.

apply.via: Studieoptag, the school's own portal (not optagelse.dk)

languageOfInstruction.note: Dance and Choreography is taught entirely in English. The school's other bachelor programmes are taught mainly in Danish.

sources.title: Dance and Choreography is taught entirely in English. Programmes are free for EU citizens, who pay a fee to the Danish copyright organisation; students from outside the EU/EEA pay EUR 10,300 per semester. The school year runs from August to June.
sources.quote: On the study programme, Dance and Choreography, all teaching is in English since about half of the students enrolled in the programme are from abroad. [...] The study programmes at DASPA are free of charge for all EU-citizens. However, you will be charged a fee for the Danish copyright organization that covers the whole study programme. [...] Students from countries that are not members of the EU of EEA will have to pay a tuition fee. The current tuition fee is 10300 EUR pr. semester. [...] The school year starts in August and finishes in June.

notes: The deadline is 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon, through the school's own Studieoptag portal. The 15 March optagelse.dk deadline does not apply, and the programme is not in KOT, so there is no grade cut-off.
The 2027 application guide is for Holstebro; the second audition there is in person. Auditions run from January to April 2027, and no exact dates are published yet.
The school is a state institution under Denmark's Ministry of Culture, which issues the executive order that governs it.

sources.title: Dance and Choreography: taught in English, a three-year full-time bachelor in Copenhagen/Holstebro; the next application deadline is 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon. Holstebro trains dance performers for the stage, Copenhagen dance makers for the independent scene. Admission is by audition.
sources.quote: teaching language english level Bachelor duration / study form 3 years / FULL-TIME place of study COPENHAGEN/HOLSTEBRO next application deadline December 1st 2026 at 12.00 (noon) [...] In Holstebro, the programme aims to graduate highly accomplished dance performers, prepared for a wide range of professional opportunities on stage. sources.title: The 2027 application is for the BFA in Dance and Choreography in Holstebro: apply on Studieoptag by 1 December 2026 at 12:00 with a four-task video audition, CV, motivation letter and a one-page art-experience text; invited applicants attend a three-day second audition in Holstebro; the application fee is DKK 750.
sources.quote: APPLY FOR THE BACHELOR OF FINE ARTS (BFA) IN DANCE AND CHOREOGRAPHY IN HOLSTEBRO APPLICATION DEADLINE December 1st 2026, at 12.00 (noon) [...] The first selection is based on a video audition. The video audition contains four different tasks. [...] The second audition takes place over a period of three days. Attendance in Holstebro is required. [...] A fee of DKK 750 will be charged when applying for admission. [...] In the audition, the admission committee will assess the applicants' level of oral English.

structure.teachingStyle: A regular day has two technique classes and a longer afternoon workshop; attendance is obligatory and some evenings and weekends are scheduled. Every year ends in a performance project with a guest choreographer.
structure.assessment: The second and third years each include an individual project; the third-year project is the graduation project.

selection.description: First round: a video audition with four tasks (a short introduction, a set phrase learnt from the school's video and filmed twice, a two-minute silent improvisation, and one to three minutes of existing choreography). Invited applicants then attend a three-day second audition in Holstebro with technique, improvisation, composition, group work and an individual interview.

sources.title: Applications for the bachelor programmes starting in August 2027 run from 1 October to 1 December 2026 at 12:00; admission tests take place from January to April 2027.
sources.quote: Fra 1. oktober til 1. december 2026 kl. 12:00 kan du søge ind på bacheloruddannelserne, som har studiestart i august 2027. [...] Optagelsesprøverne finder sted i januar-april 2027.

sources.title: Dance and Choreography is taught entirely in English. Programmes are free for EU citizens, who pay a fee to the Danish copyright organisation; students from outside the EU/EEA pay EUR 10,300 per semester. The school year runs from August to June.
sources.quote: On the study programme, Dance and Choreography, all teaching is in English since about half of the students enrolled in the programme are from abroad. [...] The study programmes at DASPA are free of charge for all EU-citizens. However, you will be charged a fee for the Danish copyright organization that covers the whole study programme. [...] Students from countries that are not members of the EU of EEA will have to pay a tuition fee. The current tuition fee is 10300 EUR pr. semester. [...] The school year starts in August and finishes in June.

sources.title: There are no formal entry requirements for the school's bachelor programmes: every student is admitted on an admission test, judged against set criteria. Applicants of any age may apply; late applications are not considered.
sources.quote: Der er ingen formelle krav for at blive optaget på bacheloruddannelserne på Scenekunstskolen. Alle studerende bliver optaget på baggrund af en optagelsesprøve, hvor et optagelsesvalg vurderer ansøgernes egnethed ud fra fastsatte kriterier. [...] Studerende fra lande, der ikke er medlem af EU og EØS skal betale en studieafgift. Studieafgiften er på nuværende tidspunkt 10.300 EUR pr. semester.
